primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATING (a fix: the benefit is proven on Paper). The 20 s endpoint (an escape-associated water proxy anchored on dig evidence both builds write; see the read's header): R_E = (r_T,post / r_T,pre) / (r_C,post / r_C,pre) per eligible opportunity, E0 = N_T,post * r_T,pre * r_C,post / r_C,pre from a FIXED 48 h pre-deploy baseline, observed count, one-sided whole-pool randomization p (favourable) with the assignment count and the minimum attainable p; undefined ratios are reported as null, never pseudocounted. harm.note: GATING: unchanged -- the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid.
